headline: GTA VI raises $3,790 million on its launch day
summary: Rockstar Games said GTA VI had sold 32.5 million units before its launch, a record across all platforms. The reported launch-day revenue was 3,790 million dollars.
why: Take-Two Interactive owns Rockstar Games, and the Grand Theft Auto franchise is one of the largest revenue sources in the video game industry, so its sales directly affect the parent company's results.
original_headline: GTA VI recauda 3,790 millones de dólares en el día de su lanzamiento
